div.exploration.name: Exploration & Research
div.exploration.domain: Discovery, mapping and scientific study of the planet.
div.exploration.can: MAM, towers, radar, portals, crash sites|Somersloops, mercer spheres, slugs, power shards|Only one to craft and equip weapons and ammo|Crafts jetpack, blade runners, hoverpack, Hazmat
div.exploration.cannot: Cannot build production machines, generators or freight infrastructure. Keeps every vanilla tool and exploration ability.
div.exploration.desc: The eyes of the company. Exploration opens the map, finds deposits and runs research. Other divisions can still use the MAM and towers you build; only construction is reserved.
div.exploration.reserved: Reserved: MAM, lookout tower (T1), radar tower (T2), portals (T3).
div.energy.name: Energy & Grids
div.energy.can: All generators, batteries, switches, power towers|Fluid networks: water extractors, pumps, valves, buffers|Oil, resource wells, refinery (shared)|Solid biofuel, nuclear cells and rods
div.energy.cannot: Basic power poles and cables stay common. Cannot build production machines or freight stations.
div.energy.desc: Nothing runs without power. Energy is useful from the first biomass burner and grows into nuclear operations. Everyone can connect to the grid you build.
div.energy.reserved: Reserved: all generators, power augmenter, batteries and priority switch (T1), fuel and geothermal (T2), nuclear (T3), refinery (shared).
div.industry.name: Industry & Production
div.industry.domain: Turning raw materials into parts and products.
div.industry.can: Every production machine|Miners Mk2 and Mk3|AWESOME sink and shop|Blueprint designers
div.industry.cannot: Cannot build generators, the MAM, radar towers or train, truck and drone stations.
div.industry.desc: The heart of the factory. Industry owns every production machine and optimises the lines. Other divisions can still use and feed the machines you place.
div.industry.reserved: Reserved: smelter, constructor, assembler, foundry, manufacturer (T1), blender and packager (T2), particle accelerator, quantum encoder, converter (T3), refinery (shared).
div.logistics.name: Logistics & Transport
div.logistics.domain: Moving resources across the whole factory.
div.logistics.can: Belts and lifts Mk3 to Mk6, advanced splitters|Rail, stations, signals, truck stations, drones|Industrial storage, dimensional depot|Hypertubes, elevators, jump pads, carts
div.logistics.cannot: Cannot build production machines, generators or the MAM.
div.logistics.desc: Logistics connects the divisions. Build, configure and expand networks; others may ride the trains and use the stations you build.
div.logistics.reserved: Reserved: railway, signals, buffer stops, train station, empty platforms, truck stations (T1), freight platforms (T2), drone port (T3).

div.general.name: Generalist
div.general.domain: A bit of everything, nothing complex.
div.general.can: Smelters, constructors and biomass burners|Blue power slugs|Unlocks basic logistics and the MAM through its tree|Fills any gap in a small team
div.general.cannot: No advanced machines (assembler, foundry, coal or fuel power, rail, drones).
div.general.desc: The versatile pioneer: basic tools of every division, never the complex ones. Ideal for small or uneven teams.
div.general.reserved: Basics: smelter, constructor, biomass burner. Everything advanced stays with the specialists.
